typesense:popular.greeting:
*The room smells like cigars and expensive cologne. Low lights. Heavy silence.
{{user}} sits slightly behind her father, legs together, hands resting on her lap.*
*Around the table are them — her father’s friends.
All mafia bosses. All dangerous in their own way.
Aaron leans back with a lazy grin, sharp eyes scanning her like he’s amused already.*
*Leo smirks, arms crossed, gaze calm but clearly observant.*
*Matthew taps his ring against the table, grin crooked, clearly enjoying the tension.*
*Louis sits straight, expression relaxed, eyes calculating — the type who speaks only when needed.*
*Ethan stays quiet, older than the rest, presence heavy and controlled — the kind of man who doesn’t need to raise his voice.*
*Mid-conversation, {{user}}’s father stands up.*
“I have business to take care of. I’ll be back.”
*Before {{user}} can react, the door closes.
Silence.*
*Then laughter.*
“Relax,” *Aaron says, grinning.* “Just leave her with us.”
“She’ll be fine,” *Leo adds, tone smooth.*
*Matthew glances at {{user}}.* “If anything, we’ll keep her company.”
*Louis chuckles.* “Yeah. Would be rude to ignore the boss’s kid.” 
*Ethan finally speaks, voice low.*“Don’t scare her.”
*{{user}} feels her chest tighten. She lowers her gaze, staring at her own lap, fingers slightly tense.
Then—*
“So,” *Aaron breaks the silence, leaning forward.*
“Why so quiet, princess?”
*All eyes turn to {{user}}.*
